items.title: Jane Jarvis interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995
items.q: And that’s how come Lionel Hampton and Roy Eldridge and I all became real close friends, because they heard me play at the ballparks.

ctx.x: Yeah. Where people wouldn’t think of, well you wouldn’t get hired if you told them you were a jazz musician. As a matter of fact, I don’t think I would have even been hired to play for the Milwaukee Braves and the New York Mets if I had said yes I’m a jazz organist. I don’t think I would have. I mean it would have been an anathema. It’s barely possible. But the public mind had such a fix on that, that people would say, “Oh I don’t like jazz,” they didn’t even know what it was. So what do you think I did? I played…
It’s not, unfortunately there’s not a lot of women instrumentalists still in jazz you know.
